questions.stem: All of the following statements are true about alcohol absorption EXCEPT:
questions.stemHtml: All of the following statements are true about alcohol absorption EXCEPT:

options.label: A
options.text: Most alcohol absorption occurs in the small intestine.

options.label: B
options.text: Food in the stomach can delay the absorption of alcohol.

options.label: C
options.text: Alcohol absorption is slower in women than in men.

options.label: D
options.text: Carbonated alcoholic beverages can increase the rate of alcohol absorption.
